senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טלל)to move, shake, hang over; denom. צֵל.

units: Koh. R. to XII, 7; Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ bot., a. e. (ref. to צולה, Is. XLIV, 27) why is Babylonia called tsulah, ששם צָלְלוּ מיתי וכ׳ because there sank the corpses of the generation of the flood; Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) צללו מי מבול (corr. acc.); v. infra.—3) (cmp. שָׁקַע) to settle, be clear; to clarify.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 3:11">Tosef. Nidd. III, 11</cite> <he>צָלְלוּ לא יחזור וכ׳</he> if the mixture has settled (become clear), he must not stir it up again; <cite ref="Niddah 20a:91">Nidd. 20ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00749"><he>עָכַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:2:7">Y. Keth. I, 25ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>וחוזרת וצוֹלֶלֶת</he>, v. <he>צָכַר</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80">Gen. R. s. 80</cite>, end <he>וצָלַלְנוּ</he>, v. <he>צָכַר</he>; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>צָלוּל</he>; f. <he>צְלוּלָה</he>; pl. <he>צְלוּלִים</he>, <he>צְלוּלִין</he>; <he>צְלוּלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 5:3:2">Y. Ter. V, end, 43ᵈ</cite> <he>יין צ׳</he> clarified wine.

<cite ref="Shabbat 109a:3">Sabb. 109ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 139b:12">139ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 71ᵃ (play on <he>צלול</he>, K’ri <cite ref="R00518"><he>צליל</he></cite>, <cite ref="Judges 7:13">Jud. VII, 13</cite>) <he>על שצלול היה אותו הדור וכ׳</he> (not <he>על שצלל עליהם</he>, v. Rashi to Jud. l. c.) because that generation was cleared (bared) of righteous men; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 18:1">Pesik. R. s. 18</cite> <he>שצליל עליהם</he> corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 62:1">Yalk. Jud. 62</cite>, <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 643:17">Yalk. Lev. 643</cite> (corr. acc.).—[

senses.gloss: to glisten, be bright; (of sound) to vibrate, ring; v. מְצִילָּה, צִלְצֵל &c.]
to be cleared. Y. Nidd. II, end, 50ᵇ יִצָּלְלוּ ולא יעכרו, v. עָכַר.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:2">Sabb. XX, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 139b:12">139ᵇ</cite>) <he>שיִצַּלּוּ</he> (Bab. ed. <he>שיִצּוֹלּוּ</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) that they (the dregs) may settle.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 8:11">Par. VIII, 11</cite> <he>עד שתָּצֵל</he> until it is settled.

<cite ref="Pesachim 50a">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>מצלות</he>, <cite ref="Zechariah 14:20">Zech. XIV, 20</cite>) there will be an addition to the sacred precincts of Jerusalem <he>עד שהסוס רץ ומֵיצֵל</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ומֵצֵיל</he>; Rashi: <he>עד שעה שהסרס וכ׳</he>) as far as a horse can run (from sunrise) until it gives shade (casts its shadow under itself, i.e. till noon-time; Y. ib. III, end, 30ᵇ <he>עד מקום שהסוס רץ ואינו עושה צל</he>); Bab. l. c. <he>כל ביזה … עד שהסוס רץ ומיצל וכ׳</he> whatever booty Israel will make (from morning) to the time &c., will be sacred &c.

<cite ref="Zevachim 113b:13">Zeb. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>שכל מתי מבול נִצְטַלְּלוּ לשם</he> Ms. R. a. K. (ed. <he>נִצְתַּלְּלוּ שם</he>) because all the corpses of the flood were dumped there (in Babylonia); <cite ref="Shabbat 113b">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite>; v. supra.
